text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: —Haaaaaaaaaaaah...!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(Desire-chan...! Her feelings of 'I want 
to win' and 'I will definitely win'... 
they pierce straight to my heart! It's 
suffocating... but—)

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
"Buena Vistaaaaa!!" "Buenaaaaaaa!!" 
"Buena-chaaaaan!!!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh! Hyaaaaaaaahhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
BUENA VISTAAAA!! She has achieved the 
Triple Tiara!! Her name is etched into 
historyyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
"Congratulations on achieving the Triple 
Tiara!" "What a monumental feat...!" 
"Thank you for moving us so deeply~~!" 
"Buena-chan, you're the absolute best--!!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, Whoa...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista looked around, deeply moved. 
Regardless of whose fan they were, 
everyone was offering cheers and applause 
for her incredible feat...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was such a... warm, beautiful sight.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Incredible... This is it...! The 
breathtaking view of the Triple Tiara...—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(A joy so overwhelming it makes me
tremble 
is welling up inside...! This must be—how 
everyone feels!)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
—When everyone is happy, I'm happy too. 
What a blessing this is...
What incredible 
strength!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Everyone,
thank you so much! Thank you all 
so very much...!!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, not yet...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Even with Cafe-san's guidance, is this 
still... not enough? If so..."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Just how much training must one
undergo... 
to reach that place?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
—...Normally,
one would fall into despair. 
Yet, I am different, wouldn't you say...?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...I offer my gratitude.
For bestowing yet 
another trial upon me. Thus, I can 
become... an even better saint.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...Now, next is that race. My beloved is 
waiting for me...♪

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~~... That was amazing, Buena Vista! 
Man, it really struck a chord with me—

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
!! Ugh,
I totally get it...!! Even the way 
Buena-chan runs is so full of effort... 
and on top of that, she's such an angel!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
She really makes you wanna cheer for her! 
She's gonna do big things next year too…… 
Man, let's totally, totally stan her!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...That was the real deal.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It seems... we've gained some 
delightful traveling companions.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Don't you dare mess with her, got it? 
âShe's my prey.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I won't fool around. I am well aware that 
she is no easy opponent...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dashing back vigorously, she held up her 
hand. —She's asking for a high five... 
Realizing this, I immediately responded.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Smack!)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you saw that, right? Such an 
incredible, breathtaking view...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
That was amazing. It gave me absolute 
chills...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I couldn't help but think. That 
I can... I can aim even higher.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Because... during Spe-san's Japan Cup, 
everyone was cheering...
with so much more 
joy.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Let's aim again for that 
breathtaking sight... one that'll burn 
into everyone's eyes and touch their very 
souls!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista's eyes sparkled with a round, 
bright glow. Her dream hasn't ended—in 
fact, her heart has already begun walking 
toward the next vista.
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's go see an even more am...
Yeah, let's go see an even more am...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yeah!
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's go see an even more br...
Yeah, let's go see an even more br...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
—Still, an even more incredible view... 
How could I ever get to see that, I 
wonder?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Our very own breathtaking view. Even more 
amazing than the sights we saw today...
choice_data_list: It's different from Spe's Japan Cu...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...! Trainer, that might be it!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Hey, let's go watch the Japan Cup. Our 
origin... Don't you think the clue might 
be there?
choice_data_list: Then... you're not going to run?
So... you're not going to run?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Because I want to feel that exact 
same way... looking at it from the same 
perspective as "everyone." Without that, 
it wouldn't be our dream.
choice_data_list: Then... you're not going to enter ...
Then... you're not going to enter ...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"To climb even higher than where I am 
today, I need to see this with my own two 
eyes!"
choice_data_list: Got it. Now, what should we do for...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yes! How about the Arima Kinen?
choice_data_list: Understood. Now, what should our t...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen is the grand finale Grand 
Prix of the year. Umamusume who define 
their era take the stage to meet the
fans' 
expectations.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
So many people cheered for me, right? 
Their voices gave me strength. I have to 
repay them!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Between the girls on the Classic Triple 
Crown route and our Senior-class 
upperclassmen... it'll be a tough field. 
Even so...
choice_data_list: If it's you, you can win.
If it's you, you can win.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. I believe that too—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our next goal was decided: the 
Arima Kinen!
